# Markets Insider

> > Real-time financial market data, news, and analysis covering stocks, indices, commodities, currencies, and global markets.

Markets Insider provides live quotes, charts, and comprehensive market data for equities, major indices (S&P 500, Dow Jones, NASDAQ 100), commodities (silver, platinum, natural gas), and forex pairs. The platform features premarket trading data, index components, analyst commentary from institutions like Morgan Stanley and Deutsche Bank, and coverage of global economic events.

## Key Topics

- S&P 500
- NASDAQ 100
- Dow Jones
- Real-time market data
- Stock prices and quotes
- Commodity trading
- Precious metals (silver, platinum)
- Oil markets
- Currency exchange rates
- Premarket trading
- Index performance
- Market analysis
- Financial news
- Live pricing data
- Global market indices

## Core Market Data

- [Markets Insider: Stock Market News, Realtime Quotes and Charts](https://markets.businessinsider.com/): Homepage with real-time market data, news on stocks, commodities, currencies
- [Stock Quotes | Stock Charts | Quote Prices](https://markets.businessinsider.com/stocks): Stock quotes, prices, charts and company analysis for all equities
- [Premarket | Futures | Pre-market Trading](https://markets.businessinsider.com/premarket): Premarket quotes for futures, indices, commodities and currencies

## Major U.S. Indices

- [S&P 500 INDEX TODAY | INX LIVE TICKER](https://markets.businessinsider.com/index/s&p_500): S&P 500 live ticker with real-time quotes, charts and constituents
- [Dow Jones INDEX TODAY | DJIA LIVE TICKER](https://markets.businessinsider.com/index/dow_jones): Dow Jones Industrial Average live ticker with quotes and historical data
- [NASDAQ 100 INDEX TODAY | NDX LIVE TICKER](https://markets.businessinsider.com/index/nasdaq_100): NASDAQ 100 live ticker with real-time tech stock index data and charts
- [S&P 500 Stock | S&P 500 Companies | S&P 500 Value](https://markets.businessinsider.com/index/components/s&p_500): Complete list of S&P 500 companies with live prices and performance data

## Commodities & Energy Markets

- [Silver PRICE Today | Silver Spot Price Chart](https://markets.businessinsider.com/commodities/silver-price): Silver spot price with live quotes, charts and precious metals data
- [Platinum PRICE Today | Platinum Spot Price Chart](https://markets.businessinsider.com/commodities/platinum-price): Platinum spot price with live precious metals quotes and trading data
- [Natural Gas PRICE Today | Natural Gas Spot Price Chart](https://markets.businessinsider.com/commodities/natural-gas-price): Natural gas Henry Hub spot price with live energy market data and charts

## Currencies & Global Markets

- [EUR USD | Chart | Euro - United States Dollar](https://markets.businessinsider.com/currencies/eur-usd): EUR/USD forex pair with live exchange rates, charts and converter
- [US Dollar Index | Global Market Indices](https://markets.businessinsider.com/index/us-dollar-index): US Dollar Index (DXY) with historical data and global market indices

## Financial News & Analysis

- [News | Financial and Business News](https://markets.businessinsider.com/news): Financial news on stocks, indices, commodities, bonds with analyst views
